reviews.title: Overwhelming interface
reviews.text:
Horrible user experience for my ADHD when setting up the app.
First time usage, got the 1-year-plan and now there is too much going on, too much pop ups, too much color, then suddenly some videos start I can’t stop before I even take in the whole interface, too much text to read through (challenge tab) to easily filter the important information on how this works…just overall distracting and overwhelming, I did not even make it more than 5mins and had to close it.
Don’t know if I want to even open it again, will cancel the plan and would not recommend for neurodivergent people.

reviews.title: Such a scam

reviews.title: I want a refund
reviews.text: Unsatisfied with the app. Found it to use manipulative tactics, insulting and the legal documents that one has to agree to before using eliminates any recourse. The subscription cost was not specified beforehand and 1 week was not enough time for someone with ADHD (those they claim to help) to sort out the app. I am disappointed and not satisfied. I want a refund. I should not have to pay a year subscription for something I have had less than two weeks.

reviews.title: Cute design but not worth the time and money bc too overcomplicated and time-consuming
reviews.text:
I was looking for a simple app where I could just add tasks, check them off when done, and see a weekly, monthly, or yearly overview. Unfortunately, this app is far too complicated for that.

Adding tasks takes a lot of time, even though the same things can be done much faster with the basic Reminders app. The interface is cute, but beyond that, it feels time-consuming and not worth the money. Overall, it creates more effort instead of simplifying things.
